items.summary: Approve keeping SearchWoot private. The prepared permission request remains owner-authorized outreach only; it must not be sent, change launch status, or bypass Legal, Security, accuracy, privacy, or measurement gates. Approve no new production work or spend this cycle. Continue only existing failed-run containment, deployed-improvement measurement, and bounded read-only security evidence capture using available telemetry and retained artifacts; preserve unknowns and do not infer revenue, ROI, margin, incrementality, causal lift, or operational health.

CFO's rejection of both CRO initiatives is technically supported. Do not create implementation or integration work for either proposal this cycle. Reconsider only after the required isolated evidence, ownership, source-rights review, cost boundaries, and measurement prerequisites exist.
